angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 620,564 km at 177.91 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6209 +/- 0.0153 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 177.91 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.892 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Southworth et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-42 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract): 620,564 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.951 +/- 0.063 solar masses from Southworth et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-42 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5315 +/- 79 K from Southworth et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-42 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Southworth et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-42 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-42.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.516, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-42: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-42 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.29 dex, from Southworth et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-42 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.36094, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-42 (pscomppars): age 4.4 Gyr, from Southworth et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-42 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.7 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
